summary: Wave 9 — Regional Discovery Engine LATAM. Backend: 28/28 wave9 pytest pass on preview URL — regional helper unit (region_score 60/25/15, regional_sort CO/MX/US), Discovery Related (?country=CO, Accept-Language: es-CO, no-country baseline; user_country propagated; CO seeds ordered first), Trending scopes (country=only CO w=1.0; latam⊂LATAM_PLUS_ES; global excludes CO; all mixes by effective score with CO items on top), Trending no-country (base_score present, regional_weight≈1.0), Search regional (Accept-Language: es-CO → first 6 companies all country=CO under by_type.companies), Suggested (?country=CO returns bancolombia/grupo-sura + user_country='CO'), CO companies seeded (bancolombia/grupo-sura/grupo-nutresa/ecopetrol/alpina/avianca all 200 country=CO; /api/companies?country=CO&limit=20 includes rappi + universidades), CO sources seeded (co-eltiempo/co-larepublica/co-portafolio/co-semana/co-mintic/co-supersociedades/co-ccb all present), PATCH /api/community/auth/me/region (valid CO=200, invalid ZZ=422, all 21 codes accepted AR/BO/BR/CL/CO/CR/CU/DO/EC/SV/GT/HN/MX/NI/PA/PY/PE/UY/VE/ES/US), E2E cookie session picks user_country from stored field, regression (community/stats, mongodb/google/bancolombia related all 200 + bancolombia similar contains CO seeds). Regression suite: 77/77 pass across wave6_auth_email + wave6_extended + wave7_growth + wave8a_ecosystem + wave8b_prodready + discovery + sources_center + growth (target was 58, exceeded). Frontend: region chip data-testid='workspace-region-chip' visible on desktop (1440x900) with initial label 'Estados Unidos' (US inferred from navigator); clicking opens data-testid='workspace-region-picker'; clicking data-testid='workspace-region-option-CO' changes label to 'Colombia' and closes picker; localStorage['pcone_country']='CO' persists across reload; after CO selection Trending items favor CO (Rappi/Universidad Nacional appear); /empresas/bancolombia renders with country=CO, related news + sobre nosotros + enlaces + ubicación sections, no empty gaps at both 1440 and 360. Responsive: no horizontal scroll at 360/414/768/1440 (scrollWidth==clientWidth). ONE FINDING: the region chip is present in the DOM at all breakpoints but only VISIBLE at desktop widths (workspace sidebar with ProfileCardWidget is hidden on ≤lg viewports on the anon Home). This means mobile/tablet users cannot reach the region picker via UI — they can only get regionalization via navigator language auto-guess or by first visiting desktop. Backend regional weighting still applies for them via X-Region-Country header seeded by useUserRegion hook.

ui_bugs.issue: workspace-region-chip is present in DOM but NOT visible on mobile/tablet viewports (360/414/768). ProfileCardWidget lives inside the desktop-only workspace sidebar on the anon Home. Spec requires 'region chip visible and clickable' at 360/414/768/1440. Chip only visible/clickable at 1440.

action_items: Consider exposing the region chip on mobile/tablet — either mirror it inside the mobile top-nav or the bottom-nav 'Mi Espacio' pane so anon users on phones can pick their country. Backend already regionalizes via X-Region-Country header, so any UI entry point is sufficient (a small flag button in the header works).
critical_code_review_comments: regional.py: LATAM_PLUS_ES intentionally boosts ES into the LATAM tier — this is documented and desired. filter_scope treats country ⊂ LATAM (good).
regional_sort is stable (uses sorted with tier_rank key) — recency inside tiers is preserved as required.
PATCH /api/community/auth/me/region accepts US alongside 20 LATAM codes (21 total accepted) — matches spec.

Frontend platformService/feedService attach X-Region-Country from localStorage['pcone_country'] — anonymous users get regional content once a country is picked (verified via Trending CO-favored after localStorage set).
Search response uses by_type.companies (not top-level companies) — this is the existing shape; any external consumers depending on top-level key would need to adapt (not a Wave 9 issue).

Trending scope=all effective ordering is by score = base_score * regional_weight (highest first), not by regional_weight alone — this matches 'boosts by regional_weight' semantically and produces expected CO-first ordering when a CO user has seeds.

useUserRegion hook default appears to be US inferred from navigator language — for a Spanish-preview user with es-CO in Accept-Language the backend correctly picks CO, but the frontend default label still shows 'Estados Unidos' until the user picks or the navigator is es-XX. Consider aligning frontend default guess with backend Accept-Language parsing.

success_rate.frontend: 12/13 spec assertions (region chip not visible on mobile viewports is the exception)

seed_data_creation: None. Only PATCH /me/region called (idempotent, restores to 'CO' at end of run).
